fields.label: Intro curtain duration
fields.description: Opening/closing speed for the intro curtain in milliseconds.

fields.label: Tab open/close duration
fields.description: Opening/closing speed for the instructions tab in milliseconds.

fields.label: Tab closed extra offset
fields.description: Extra offset (in px) applied when the tab is closed. 0 keeps it flush; higher values hide it more.

fields.label: Gradient angle
fields.description: Direction in degrees (0 = upward, 180 = downward).

fields.label: Text padding
fields.description: Inner spacing around the intro text and start button, in rem.

fields.label: Gradient angle
fields.description: Direction in degrees (0 = upward, 180 = downward).

fields.label: Gradient angle
fields.description: Direction in degrees (0 = upward, 180 = downward).

fields.label: Button border radius
fields.description: Corner roundness in rem units.

fields.label: Button width
fields.description: Maximum width of the Start button in rem. The button never exceeds 100% of the available space.

fields.label: Gradient angle
fields.description: Direction in degrees (0 = upward, 180 = downward).

fields.label: Text padding
fields.description: Inner spacing of the tab content panel, in rem.

fields.label: Gradient angle
fields.description: Direction in degrees (0 = upward, 180 = downward).

fields.label: Gradient angle
fields.description: Direction in degrees (0 = upward, 180 = downward).

fields.label: Button border radius
fields.description: Corner roundness in rem units.

fields.label: Alternative text for Image
fields.description: Describe what can be seen in the photo. The text is read by text-to-speech tools needed by visually impaired users.

fields.label: Audio Track
fields.description: An optional sound that plays when the card is turned.

fields.label: Matching Image
fields.description: An optional image to match against instead of using two cards with the same image.

fields.label: Alternative text for Matching Image
fields.description: Describe what can be seen in the photo. The text is read by text-to-speech tools needed by visually impaired users.

fields.label: Matching Audio Track
fields.description: An optional sound that plays when the second card is turned.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: An optional short text that will pop up once the two matching cards are found.

semantics.label: Behavioural settings
semantics.description: These options will let you control how the game behaves.

fields.label: Position the cards in a square
fields.description: Will try to match the number of columns and rows when laying out the cards. Afterward, the cards will be scaled to fit the container.

fields.label: Number of cards to use
fields.description: Setting this to a number greater than 2 will make the game pick random cards from the list of cards.

fields.label: Add button for retrying when the game is over
Show time spent
fields.description: Display the elapsed time under the cards. This is only a timer; it does not affect the score.

fields.label: Show card turns
fields.description: Display the number of card turns under the cards.

fields.label: Enable time limit
fields.description: If enabled, the player must finish before the countdown reaches zero. Otherwise the activity is failed.

fields.label: Time limit (seconds)
fields.description: Countdown duration in seconds. The marker shows minutes:seconds (for example 30 → 0:30, 180 → 3:00, 1800 → 30:00).

fields.label: Enable card turn limit
fields.description: If enabled, the activity fails when the maximum number of card turns is reached before all pairs are found.

fields.label: Maximum card turns
fields.description: Maximum number of card flips allowed. Each flip of a card counts as one turn.

semantics.label: Look and feel
semantics.description: Control the visuals of the game.

fields.label: Theme Color
fields.description: Choose a color to create a theme for your card game.

fields.label: Card Back
fields.description: Use a custom back for your cards.

fields.label: Play area background color
fields.description: Background color of the 16:9 game area behind the cards.

fields.label: Success feedback color
fields.description: Text color for the success message shown when all pairs are found.

fields.label: Failed feedback color
fields.description: Text color for the failure message shown when a time or turn limit is reached.

fields.label: Card border radius
fields.description: Corner roundness of the cards, in pixels.

fields.label: Card border width
fields.description: Border thickness of the cards, in pixels.

fields.label: Card border color
fields.description: Border color of the cards. Theme color may still tint borders when a theme is set.

fields.label: Matched card opacity
fields.description: Opacity of cards after a pair is found, as a percentage (0 = invisible, 100 = fully opaque).

fields.label: Card front symbol
fields.description: Character shown on the unturned card face when no front image is used. Leave empty to use a question mark.

fields.label: Card front image
fields.description: Optional image for the unturned card face. When set, it replaces the front symbol.

fields.label: Card flip duration
fields.description: Duration of the flip animation in milliseconds.

fields.label: Description popup background color
fields.description: Background color of the popup shown when a pair has a description.

fields.label: Description popup header background color
fields.description: Background color of the image area at the top of the description popup.

fields.label: Description popup text color
fields.description: Text color inside the description popup.

fields.label: Retry button
fields.description: Action button style for the reset control shown when the game ends (same pattern as other CFRD 1.0 libraries).

fields.label: Gradient angle
fields.description: Direction in degrees (0 = upward, 180 = downward).

fields.label: Button border radius
fields.description: Corner roundness in rem units.

fields.label: Failed due to time label
fields.description: Shown under the status bar when the time limit is reached (retry dialog).

fields.label: Failed due to turns label
fields.description: Shown under the status bar when the card turn limit is reached (retry dialog).

fields.label: Game label
fields.default: Memory Game. Find the matching cards.

fields.label: Game instructions
fields.default: Use arrow keys left and right to navigate cards. Use space or enter key to turn card.

fields.label: Game finished label
fields.default: All of the cards have been found.
fields.description: Shown under the status bar when the player finds all pairs (retry dialog).

fields.label: Card indexing label
fields.description: %num and %total are placeholders and will be replaced with the respective values for the card.

fields.label: Card not matched announcement
fields.default: Your chosen cards do not match. Turn other cards to try again.
